title: Entomancer

moves.title: Pheromone Spit
effects: Apply 1 Hive (if current Hive < 3), or 2 Strength (if Hive ≥ 3)
Also applies 1 Strength when applying Hive

move_pattern: Cycles through: Beeeees! → Spear! → Pheromone Spit → repeats
notes: Pheromone Spit has conditional scaling: if current Hive stacks are below 3, it applies 1 Hive and 1 Strength; once Hive reaches 3 or higher, it applies 2 Strength instead. This creates a scaling mechanic where the monster builds up Hive in early turns then switches to pure Strength scaling.
